verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents its own full-text thread search across sender, recipients, subject and body, with results ranked by relevance, and threads can be retrieved across an entire organization rather than one inbox. The docs do not evidence search operators, structured filters or speed. The LangChain vector-store RAG path is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented search operators/query syntax, documented filters (date, label, sender, etc.), evidence of speed/performance at full-history scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
you can retrieve them in two powerful ways: scoped to a single `Inbox` or across your entire `Organization`.
